Our story

To bag, or not to bag?

Hi, I'm Vicki. The Handmade Hamlet started at my sewing table in Bellingham, making bags for the people I love: something to hold a kid's treasures on a lake day, or a phone and keys on a long walk.

What I love most is the part before the sewing starts: hearing who a bag is for, what makes them light up, which colors feel like them. From there I pull together fabrics I think they'll love, and we figure out the rest together.

Every bag is one outside fabric and one inside fabric, an adjustable strap, and a single zip compartment. Simple, sturdy, and made to be worn hard. The fun is in making each one completely its own.

— Vicki

How to order

It starts with a conversation

There's no shopping cart here. Every bag is custom, so ordering is a chat with Vicki: you share what you have in mind, and together you land on the design and a timeline that works.

1

Reach out

Email or message Vicki. A few sentences is plenty to get started.

2

Share the details

Who it's for, what they love, colors, size, and when you'd like it.

3

Design it together

Vicki suggests fabrics and ideas. You go back and forth until it's just right, and agree on timing.

4

Vicki bakes it

She sews your one-of-a-kind bag by hand and sends it your way.

Helpful things to include

  • Who it's forYou, a kid, a gift for someone special
  • What they loveHobbies, animals, favorite books, a vibe
  • ColorsFavorites, and any they can't stand
  • SizeSee the chart, or just tell Vicki their age
  • TimingA birthday or trip date if you have one
